# flotilla

> A small platform for agent fleets: flotillad (Go) schedules routines, keeps cases, the ledger and the operator UI, and dispatches each run to a worker (Python, in Docker, on the mini or a remote machine). The fleets: triage (alerts and errors to GitHub issues), bugfix (an issue to a draft fix), ops (backups and host checks), SEO, and platform checks.

Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md imports it); bugfix-fleet/AGENTS.md is scoped to that folder. Decisions are ADRs under docs/adr/ and proposals RFCs under docs/rfc/; how the system fits together is docs/architecture/; how to run each fleet is docs/operations/. Each routine is a spec in fleets/<fleet>/<routine>.yaml.

This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and `make lint` (CI) fails when it is stale.

- [Where to look](AGENTS.md#where-to-look): Active session log: `docs/history/` (latest file = current state).
- [What overrides this file](AGENTS.md#what-overrides-this-file): Direct instruction in chat: a one-shot ask supersedes a default.
- [bugfix-fleet/AGENTS.md](bugfix-fleet/AGENTS.md): rules scoped to the bugfix-fleet folder (the bake-off era code)

- [tests (every area)](docs/testing.md): the test tiers and what each make target runs
- [Makefile](Makefile): every gate: `make ci-fast` (lint, unit tests) on every push, `make replay` (the triage replays, needs the private corpora), `make test-e2e`, `make docs-lint`

## By service (what a triage agent needs)

- [flotillad](docs/architecture/deployment.md): GlitchTip project `flotilla` (its own ERROR logs, environment operations); container `flotillad`
- [workers and egress on the mini](deploy/compose/README.md): containers `flotilla-worker-<role>` (triage, ops-read, ops-act-host, marketing, triage-candidate) and `flotilla-egress`, `flotilla-egress-seo`; the triage fleet's logs and metrics carry service `triage-fleet` (the candidate `triage-fleet-candidate`)
- [remote workers (bugfix on the X3)](deploy/remote/README.md): containers `flotilla-remote-*`, linked to flotillad over the tailnet
- [host agents](docs/operations/host-keys.md): container `flotilla-hosts`: host actions and their keys

- [bugfix/fix](fleets/bugfix/fix.yaml): The acting routine for code_bug cases (RFC-0010 §2, §9).
- [bugfix (fleet)](fleets/bugfix/fleet.yaml): The developers: fix bugs filed against the repos they cover.

- [bugfix/open-pr](fleets/bugfix/open-pr.yaml): The executing routine for github.open_pr (RFC-0010 §3): once a person approved a plan, it checks the plan's hash …
- [bugfix/pr-check](fleets/bugfix/pr-check.yaml): The check for github.open_pr (registry check pr_resolved, RFC-0010 §3): reads the PR from flotilla/<case>, read only.
- [deps (fleet)](fleets/deps/fleet.yaml): Dependency upkeep: pinned packages with known vulnerabilities (and, where a repo asks, ones behind the latest release) …
- [deps/scan](fleets/deps/scan.yaml): For each repo in this fleet's repos.json: the pinned Python requirements on the default branch, checked against …
- [deps/upgrade](fleets/deps/upgrade.yaml): The acting routine for dependency_update cases: re-checks the pin on the repo's default branch now, and plans …
- [jobs/backup-monitor](fleets/jobs/backup-monitor.yaml): Reads when the backup last succeeded (BACKUP_METRIC, a metric of epoch seconds, for the instance BACKUP_INSTANCE) and …
- [jobs (fleet)](fleets/jobs/fleet.yaml): Job keeper: the jobs a business runs every night, kept running.
- [jobs/rerun-backup](fleets/jobs/rerun-backup.yaml): The acting routine for failed_backup cases: re-checks the backup's age with fresh numbers and plans backup.rerun on the …
- [jobs/verify-backup](fleets/jobs/verify-backup.yaml): The check for backup.rerun (the registry's check backup_newer_than_execution): while a case is in checking, it reads …
- [platform (fleet)](fleets/platform/fleet.yaml): flotilla checking itself: the scheduler, a worker, the store, egress through the proxy and telemetry, every 10 minutes …
- [platform/heartbeat](fleets/platform/heartbeat.yaml): The platform's own canary: proves the scheduler, a worker, the store, egress through the proxy (an allowed host …
- [platform/model-contract](fleets/platform/model-contract.yaml): Contract checks (G15): every model alias named below, once a day and on demand from Models and spend; an alias added to …
- [review/case-review](fleets/review/case-review.yaml): The post-incident review (ADR-0016): reads the cases closed in the last 7 days and proposes what to learn, each …
- [review (fleet)](fleets/review/fleet.yaml): Post-incident review: after cases close, the system looks at what happened and proposes what to learn, as a post-mortem …
- [review/process-change](fleets/review/process-change.yaml): The acting routine for process_change cases (ADR-0016): re-checks the proposal against the repo files of its image and …
- [sites (fleet)](fleets/sites/fleet.yaml): Site watch: what your websites serve live, checked every day and read only.
- [sites/site-check](fleets/sites/site-check.yaml): For each site in this fleet's sites.json: robots.txt lets the named crawlers in, every sitemap answers and lists URLs …
- [triage/cycle-shadow](fleets/triage/cycle-shadow.yaml): A candidate beside the live triage, compared in shadow: the same code on another model (the alias triage-candidate), on …
- [triage/cycle](fleets/triage/cycle.yaml): On-call triage: one pass over the firing alerts (Grafana) and the unresolved errors (GlitchTip).
- [triage (fleet)](fleets/triage/fleet.yaml): Reads alerts and errors, decides what each one is, and files what needs a fix as a GitHub issue through its ledger …

## Decisions (ADRs)

- [ADR-0001 — Platform foundations](docs/adr/ADR-0001-platform-foundations.md): Accepted
- [ADR-0002 — Run flotilla in Docker, one worker per fleet](docs/adr/ADR-0002-run-in-docker.md): Accepted. ADR-0001 puts flotilla on the homelab mini, as the `claude` account.
- [ADR-0003 — Dependencies, spec format and base images for flotillad](docs/adr/ADR-0003-dependencies-and-images.md): Accepted. Phase 2 builds flotillad (RFC-0001 §9).
- [ADR-0004 — The job runtime: five core concepts](docs/adr/ADR-0004-job-runtime.md): Accepted. Phase 3 builds the job runtime and moves the triage fleet onto it.
- [ADR-0005 — The agent pipeline: cases, capabilities, recall, policy and the actuator](docs/adr/ADR-0005-agent-pipeline.md): Accepted. ADR-0004 gave flotilla's job runtime its core concepts, shaped around triage.
- [ADR-0006 — The flotilla node agent: host actions and connectors, on any host](docs/adr/ADR-0006-node-agent.md): Accepted. ADR-0005 needs host writes (restart a container, rerun a backup job) to run through a privileged component on each …
- [ADR-0007 — "Routine" replaces "job"](docs/adr/ADR-0007-routine.md): Accepted. "Job" named flotilla's declared unit of work: a trigger, a worker, steps and a stage, inside a fleet …
- [ADR-0008 — One autonomy scale: shadow, propose, auto](docs/adr/ADR-0008-autonomy.md): Accepted
- [ADR-0009 — Host agent names: workers think, host agents act](docs/adr/ADR-0009-host-agent-names.md): Accepted. ADR-0006 named the program flotilla installs on each host in several ways: "host agent" in prose, `flotilla-node` as …
- [ADR-0010 — Memory and knowledge, not "recall"](docs/adr/ADR-0010-memory-and-knowledge.md): Accepted. ADR-0004 named two of the runtime's core concepts memory (what flotilla recorded) and external knowledge (what exists …
- [ADR-0011 — Tools and actions, not "capabilities"](docs/adr/ADR-0011-tools-and-actions.md): Accepted. "Capability" meant two things.
- [ADR-0012 — Skills in the harness](docs/adr/ADR-0012-skills.md): Accepted. Skills (a `SKILL.md` folder of know-how, the format Claude Code and opencode read) let an agent pull in instructions …
- [ADR-0013 — Fleet packs](docs/adr/ADR-0013-fleet-packs.md): Accepted. A fleet's behaviour lives more and more in text: routine specs, playbooks, skills, harness settings.
- [ADR-0014 — The operator UI, users and roles](docs/adr/ADR-0014-operator-ui.md): Accepted. The operator works flotilla from a terminal, which is not possible on a phone.
- [ADR-0015 — The MCP server](docs/adr/ADR-0015-mcp-server.md): Accepted. Other agents (Claude sessions, the X3 assistant) had no way into flotilla but SSH and the container's CLI token, one …
- [ADR-0016 — Post-incident review](docs/adr/ADR-0016-post-incident-review.md): Accepted. The first shadow case was the chain right within a wrong check (a 20 h threshold on a ~24 h backup), and nothing in …

## Proposals (RFCs)

- [RFC-0001 — one fleet platform from the fleets we have](docs/rfc/RFC-0001-fleet-platform.md): Accepted → ADR-0001
- [RFC-0004 — The agent pipeline: from signal to verified action](docs/rfc/RFC-0004-agent-pipeline.md): Accepted → ADR-0005. RFC-0003 is reserved for the digital marketing fleet's first use case, SEO.
- [RFC-0005 — Skills in the harness](docs/rfc/RFC-0005-skills.md): Accepted → ADR-0012. A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`: a name, a "use when" description and instructions.
- [RFC-0006 — Fleet packs: flows as files, shared between people and promoted between installations](docs/rfc/RFC-0006-fleet-packs.md): Accepted → ADR-0013. A fleet's behaviour lives more and more in text: routine specs, playbooks, skills, harness settings.
- [RFC-0007 — The operator UI: from mockup v3 to pages flotillad serves](docs/rfc/RFC-0007-operator-ui.md): Accepted → ADR-0014. The operator works flotilla from a terminal today: `flotilla status`, `runs`, `pause`, `resume`, `autonomy`, and SSH to …
- [RFC-0008 — The MCP server: other agents see and steer flotilla](docs/rfc/RFC-0008-mcp-server.md): Accepted → ADR-0015. flotilla has a CLI for the operator on the mini and a UI for people.
- [RFC-0010 — Bugfix on the platform: from a bug to a draft PR, as a case](docs/rfc/RFC-0010-bugfix-on-the-platform.md): Accepted. The LiteLLM aliases `fleet-bugfix-flash`, `-pro` and `-reviewer` (glm-5.2) exist, under their own key with a $100 …
- [RFC-0011 — Remote workers: routines on any machine, the mini orchestrating](docs/rfc/RFC-0011-remote-workers.md): Accepted. Every worker runs today on the mini, beside flotillad, on its internal Docker network.
- [RFC-0012 — The SEO fleet: Orrery's search presence, measured](docs/rfc/RFC-0012-seo-fleet.md): Accepted. Orrery (`www.orrerylearn.com`, 14 locales, about 12,000 indexable pages since ADR-096) fixed what a build can check …
- [RFC-0013 — The clarifier: answering "needs info" before the fix, and asking once](docs/rfc/RFC-0013-bugfix-clarifier.md): Accepted. The first four PR plans were judged by the operator and the fleet session on 2026-11-16: one right (#648), one partial …
